You are interested in understanding how the air quality in Lethbridge has changed over the last few decades. You have downloaded data from April 1st, 2010 (the date of the first measurements) to August 27th, 2026 (when Steph downloaded the data/made this assignment) that represents measurements of nitric oxide (NO), nitrogen dioxide (NO~2~) and ozone (O~3~) made in North Lethbridge.

## Section 1: Data download and quality control check (40 points)

### Question 1: Do the following:(15 points)

i.  Import the data into R 
ii. Rename the columns to accurately represent their contents. Note renaming columns individually will result in a point deduction! 
iii. Transform one time column into a datetime format. Note the timezone is MST. 
iv. remove repeating time interval columns 
v.show the resulting dataframe by printing it with the `head()` function 

```{r Q1, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
A3Data <- read.csv("Assignment3_data.csv", skip=28)

colnames(A3Data)[1:4]<-paste0(colnames(A3Data)[1:4], "NO")

colnames(A3Data)[5:8] <-  sub(".1", "", colnames(A3Data)[5:8])
colnames(A3Data)[5:8]<-paste0(colnames(A3Data)[5:8], "NO2")

colnames(A3Data)[9:12] <-  sub(".2", "", colnames(A3Data)[9:12])
colnames(A3Data)[9:12]<-paste0(colnames(A3Data)[9:12], "O3")
A3Data <- A3Data %>%
  mutate(date=as.POSIXct(`Interval.StartNO`, tz="MST",format="%Y-%m-%j %H:%M"))
A3Data <-A3Data %>%
  select(!contains("Interval"))
head(A3Data)

```

### Question 3: In 2016, quite a bit of data was flagged with a "V". What does the "V" flag mean, and should you remove that data from consideration? (6 points)

You will need to consult the [Alberta Air Quality Data and Reports website](https://www.alberta.ca/air-quality-data-and-reports)
Data flagged with "V" is "Valid" data which passed some level of quality control and therefore does not need to be removed


### Question 4: We want to work with the long form of the data. Pivot the data to its long form, with four columns: date, pollutant, flags and measurement. Show the `head` of the long data. (10 points)
*8 points for the pivot. -2 points per extra step, 2 points for the head argument*

```{r Q4, echo = TRUE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}
  measurements <- A3Data %>%
  select(date, starts_with("Measurement.Value")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -date,
    names_to = "Pollutant",
    values_to = "Measurement"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollutant = sub("Measurement\\.Value", "", Pollutant)
  )

flags <- A3Data %>%
  select(date, starts_with("Flags")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -date,
    names_to = "Pollutant",
    values_to = "Flag"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pollutant = sub("Flags", "", Pollutant)
  )

A3Long<- left_join(
  measurements,
  flags,
  by = c("date", "Pollutant")
)

head(A3Long)
```


## Section 2: Pollutant trends over time (51 points)

### Question 5: Plot the annual average of all pollutant measurements over time of all three pollutants on a single plot, with its standard deviation. Remember the elements that make a good plot! (20 points)
Hint: it is easier *not* to use the openair package. 

```{r Q5, echo = TRUE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}
A3Annual <- A3Long %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      format(as.POSIXct(date), "%b"),
      levels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                 "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(month, Pollutant) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(A3Annual,
       aes(x = month,
           y = mean,
           colour = Pollutant,
           group = Pollutant)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.5), size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd,
        ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2,
    position= position_dodge(0.5)) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Question 6: Plot the annual-average MDA8 of ozone for Lethbridge, with its standard deviation. (15 points)

```{r Q6, echo = TRUE, warning= FALSE, message= FALSE}
O3MDA8 <- A3Long%>%
  filter(Pollutant=="O3")
O3MDA8 <- rollingMean(A3Long %>%
                      filter(Pollutant=="O3"),
                    pollutant = "Measurement",
                    width=8,
                    align = "right")
O3MDA8 <- selectByDate(O3MDA8, hour = 7:23)
O3MDA8 <- timeAverage(O3MDA8, 
                    avg.time="day",
                    statistic = "max")
O3MDA8Monthly <- O3MDA8 %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      format(as.POSIXct(date), "%b"),
      levels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                 "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
ggplot(O3MDA8Monthly, aes(x = month, y = mean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd,
        ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2
  ) 
```
